---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new algorithm, capability, or documentation improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What problem does this solve, or what gap does it close? If this is a
new algorithm preset, name its primary source (paper or reference
implementation) and note whether it fits sezgi's own equivalence-critique
discipline (see `examples/README.md`'s catalog for the established
provenance format).

## Proposed solution

A description of what you would like to see added or changed. If this
touches the Rust core, note which language frontend(s) should expose it.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative approaches you considered, and why you preferred this
one.

## Scope check

- [ ] This does not require an engine-level (`crates/core`) change to
      the RNG model or determinism guarantees, OR: it does, and I have
      described the tradeoff above.

## Additional context

Anything else relevant — related issues, prior discussion, links.
